images.prompt: Cinematic, photorealistic interior view from inside an elegant, modern, minimal luxury home, looking straight out through a large floor-to-ceiling glass window that fills most of the frame. Slim dark window frames appear only near the left and right edges; the centre of the image is an unobstructed view through the glass. A subtle hint of the calm, minimal interior at the very bottom edge (a low, clean sill and soft floor reflections) and at the extreme sides; nothing in the centre of the frame. Outside: a softly blurred, location-neutral landscape of gentle rolling hills and scattered trees, with a distant small city whose soft lights sit along the horizon; no recognizable landmarks. The horizon sits slightly below the middle of the frame. A gentle depth-of-field blur over the whole scene, as if the camera is focused on a person standing close in front of it, so a portrait reads clearly on top. Calm, premium, cinematic colour grading. Landscape 3:2 image. No people, no animals, no text, no logos. Time of day: full daytime. Bright, natural daylight and a luminous sky. Weather: clear. An open, cloudless sky; if the sun is up, warm sunlight streams in through the glass and falls softly into the room.
